_comment: Real couplings in this repo, not aspirational ones.
The chat model is INSTRUCTED to emit [c:<chunk_id>] markers by the system
prompt in llm/openrouter.py. The code that parses and strips those markers
is rag/citations.py. Change either side without reading the other and
citations silently stop rendering in the UI - the API still returns 200.
A new alembic migration must chain off the CURRENT head: set down_revision
wrong and test_migration_chain fails. You cannot know the head without
reading the latest migration, so the guard makes you read it.
